Emporia, Kansas · stay

Hotels in Emporia for cyclists

Places to stay in Emporia when you are in town to ride. Picked for being near the start, easy with a bike, or cheap. Book early for event weekends. Rooms go first.

For: Unbound Gravel.

Hotels in Emporia for cyclists, listed

  1. Holiday Inn Express & Suites Emporia Northwest

    $$ · 3007 W 18th Ave, Emporia, KS 66801

    Off I-35 on the west side, close to downtown and the university; books up early for Unbound

  2. Comfort Inn & Suites Emporia

    $$ · 2921 W 18th Ave, Emporia, KS 66801

    Near I-35 with free hot breakfast, indoor pool and pet-friendly rooms

  3. La Quinta Inn & Suites by Wyndham Emporia

    $$ · 2930 Eaglecrest Dr, Emporia, KS 66801

    Off exit 128, two miles from Emporia State; free breakfast, heated indoor pool, fridge and microwave in rooms

  4. MainStay Suites Emporia

    $$ · 2602 Candlewood Dr, Emporia, KS 66801

    Extended-stay rooms with full kitchenettes right off I-35; good for a crew staying several nights
